prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for a 2D isometric browser RPG social camp, 16:9 landscape, 1536x864 or 1536x1024 with safe 16:9 crop. Create a wilderness camp clearing in the exact visual family of the late-1990s original Lineage game: detailed prerendered isometric terrain, natural adult proportions, crisp tiny pixel-like textured edges, aged earth, mossy stones, muted olive grass and dark woodland, grounded medieval realism, not cartoon, not modern 3D, not painterly concept art. Elevated orthographic three-quarter game camera looking down, NO HORIZON OR SKY. Edge of a dense forest at dusk. Broad flat circular dirt clearing occupies the middle 70% of the image, ample empty terrain for player sprites around a campfire placed by the game. Center at 50% x, 54% y is bare dark earth and a faint warm amber pool of light, EMPTY: do not bake fire, firepit, people, furniture, text or UI into it. Scattered roots, ferns, broken rocks and old fallen logs only along outer edges. Small rolled travel blanket and a pack at far upper left edge, tiny rugged tent at far upper right edge, kept secondary. Sharp natural terrain texture, original Lineage restrained earthy colors and low-light contrast; ground readable rather than black. Fire and individual seated avatars will be separate animated layers, so center must be open and level. No text, watermark, border, people, seats or tables.
prompts.campers: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a 2D isometric wilderness social camp, matching original 1998 Lineage PC art and existing tiny adult knight/mage sprites: realistic adult proportions, muted steel/leather/cloth, small crisp detailed prerendered pixel edges, NOT chibi, NOT cartoon, NOT anime. Output exact 4 columns by 8 rows uniform grid on genuinely transparent background, total 1024 wide x 2048 high (32 square cells). No lines labels numbers or text. In EVERY row: column 1 male sitting relaxed cross-legged on ground, column 2 SAME male still seated raising open right hand to greet, column 3 female sitting relaxed cross-legged on ground, column 4 SAME female still seated raising open right hand to greet. ALL characters full body, three-quarter isometric camera viewed from above, all facing lower right / viewer, same scale with head at 24% and ground contact at 82% of each cell, maintain identical seated body position between normal and raised-hand pair. Entire character inside central 65% of each cell, no touching cell edges, no ground, no props, no painted light pools, no shadow outside character. Row1 royal prince/princess: dark brown hair, gold crown, burgundy royal tunic and muted gold cape; row2 knight: silver steel armor, male short dark hair, female dark hair ponytail; row3 elf: green woodland leather, pale long blonde hair, pointed ears; row4 mage: long dark robes with muted purple lining, male grey beard and small hood, female long black hair and purple robe; row5 dark elf: dark blue grey skin, silver hair, dark leather armor; row6 dragon knight: tarnished bronze/red scale armor, no helmet; row7 illusionist: deep purple and teal robe, long grey hair; row8 warrior: heavy dark leather and iron shoulder armor, male short red-brown hair, female long reddish hair. Hands anatomically clear but tiny. No weapons drawn, everyone resting on bare ground, warm subtle campfire rim light from front. Background must be transparent alpha, never white or checkerboard. This is an actual 32-cell game sprite sheet, exact consistent registration and grid are essential.
prompts.campfire: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 6-frame seamless loop campfire animation sprite atlas for a classic original-Lineage-style 2D isometric PC RPG. Genuine transparent alpha background. EXACT 3 columns x 2 rows uniform grid, total 1536x1024, each cell exactly 512x512. Each cell contains the SAME small campfire viewed from elevated isometric three-quarter game camera with a low oval ring of rough grey/brown stones and 3 crossed charred logs, bright amber-orange fire with tiny yellow core. No people, lettering, cell borders, ground plane or UI. Strict identical stationary ring and logs in every cell, anchored center x=256 y=375 relative to each cell, every frame identical scale, never touching cell boundaries. Flame footprint x=160..352 y=140..340, stones at x=96..416 y=320..420. SIX sequential DIFFERENT natural flame shapes, progression left to right top row then bottom row: left leaning split flame, center upright flame, right leaning tall flame, short double flame, left tall flame, center low split flame, designed to cycle back smoothly to frame1. Warm small embers above flame, delicate smoke, restrained transparent warm glow. Crisp detailed low resolution prerendered pixel texture, 1998 dark medieval RPG aesthetic, NOT vector, NOT flat, NOT cartoon, NOT huge bonfire. Must use only alpha transparency outside the object; never checkerboard or black rectangles. Registered six-frame animation asset, no camera movement or firepit geometry changes.
